newsitem.title: USA: Delta to restructure domestic routes.
newsitem.headline: Delta to restructure domestic routes.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said it will adjust its domestic route structure to establish a stronger "feeder system" for its international operations.

The domestic restructuring is more than just a seasonal route adjustment, but will be less severe than the previously announced plan overhaul the trans-Atlantic and intra-European flights, Delta spokesman Bill Berry said.
"We're looking at routes that were not as productive," Berry said. "Some cities will lose routes, some will gain routes."
Delta said it will announce the domestic route changes on Wednesday. The airline, however, denied industry speculation that it also will announce an aircraft purchase at that time.
Delta said it is in final contract negotiations to replace its fleet of L-1011s, but no decision has been made.
The airline said it is considering replacing those aircraft with the Airbus Industrie 330, the Boeing Co 777 or the Boeing 767-400.
